This after-hours bonanza includes unlimited trick-or-treating, exclusive parades and shows, rare character meet and greets, dance parties, spooky ride overlays, and of course, specialty food and drink. Discover: Things to Do at WALT DISNEY WORLD® Resort Highlights include the Hocus Pocus Villain Spelltacular, Mickey’s Boo-To-You Halloween Parade, and an all-new masquerade with Stitch. Collect sweet treats or allergy-friendly treat tokens as you explore, then see ghoulishly good fireworks, projections and lasers during the event’s grand finale, Disney’s Not-So-Spooky Spectacular.
